arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Occult{/c} Skills deal {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|x1%|]{/c} increased damage per {c_number}{SF_1}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} and gain {c_number}[{SF_2}*100|+%|]{/c} increased Size per {c_number}{SF_3}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.

With at least {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}, {c_important}Occult Abyss{/c} Skills apply {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} additional {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} to enemies on hit, and {c_important}Occult Hellfire{/c} Skills have a {c_number}[{SF_6}*100|%|]{/c} chance to grant {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} seconds when Cast.
